scientific.method: Original numeric inputs/analytic relations, domains and display points retained; full arrays and parameters saved. Curves, jump endpoints, probabilities, trajectories and label meanings checked against source.

visual.method: Every final figure inspected on actual-render contact sheets at readable size; suspect figures inspected at native resolution. 1100 px previews retained for final reading-size review.
checks: No annotation/edge collision left after fixes
Direction, endpoint and line-pattern meaning retained
Pure white background, flat geometric areas and pale module fills
specific_adjustments: 高度明确作为示意量，公式主项保留；不宣称实验比例。

typography.policy: Source Han Sans SC Normal main Chinese; LXGW WenKai notes; Fira Math English/digits/math. Only missing Fira mathematical glyphs use STIX Two Math; no synthetic bold.

color_readability: Lancet 11 palette; original yellow thin marks/text/points use Lancet Green, pale yellow fills remain. Direct labels, shapes and line patterns distinguish meanings.
